positions.name: MigrationDecisionScope
positions.frame: What database migration decision was made, from whom, and how was it recorded?
positions.why: Both expressions assert the same directional move — PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline — but in different registers: src-1 is Dave's live declarative announcement, src-3 is the structured note version, authored by Xena but keeping Dave as animator and principal. Reading them together traces the same decision's assertion across spoken and summarized form without collapsing the distinct footing each carries.

positions.name: PerformanceCostRationale
positions.frame: What performance and cost rationale is offered for the migration?
positions.why: Both expressions restate the same 10x performance figure as justification for the switch. src-2 pairs it informally with a lower-licensing-cost claim; src-4 isolates the performance figure alone in the structured note, dropping the cost claim. Read together they show the rationale being carried across registers, holding in tension that the cost benefit appears in the live assertion but not in its structured echo.
